children: Shilpa Samant New Delhi: Amid high power demand in Gujarat, the power ministry has allocated additional electricity to the state from central generating stations for both short as well as long term, people aware of the development said. Apart from Gujarat, Tamil Nadu and Jammu & Kashmir have also got additional allocation, after getting allocation requests from these states.
Gujarat got 1.6 GW, Tamil Nadu around 421 MW while Jammu & Kashmir received 329 MW, some of which are from gas-based power plants as well.

For Gujarat, this comes as a relief during the ongoing high demand from the domestic and industrial segments, one of the persons said. In Gujarat, the peak demand on October 24 was around 28.3 GW, almost the same as in much of June.

Of the total allocation to Gujarat, around 716.3 MW from NTPC power stations is an extension of the existing allocation for another year till March 2028, which was allocated in June 2022. The order dated October 19, seen by ET, said this power was to be allocated from NTPC Ltd's Barh-I and Dadri-I power stations by another year.

Another 330 MW for Gujarat is from NTPC's Farakka thermal units allocated only for November. This allocation is currently with Punjab. The state has also been allocated 164.4 MW from NEEPCO Ltd's Assam gas-based power station and 216.65 MW from NTPC's Bongaigaon thermal power station, which are long-term supplies.

The Centre allocates power from central generating stations to states based on their requirements and the availability of capacity. Such allocations can include unallocated or surrendered power. E-mail seeking response from the power ministry remained unanswered till the time of publishing. Tamil Nadu's allocation come from NTPC's Bongaigaon plant, Subansiri hydro projects and Subansiri Lower project on a long-term basis, proportionally, as and when the units are commissioned. For Jammu & Kashmir, the allocation of 329.4 MW is from relinquished power of Bihar from Farakka stage-I & II from December to February.

title: Gujarat, TN and J&K Allocated Extra Power
